title: The Wedding People
author: Alison Espach
engineRationale: Literary fiction with fictional everyman characters (Phoebe, Lila) and no real/nameable historical people to depict; internal/emotional journey (grief, second chances, connection) is exactly what the flat-vector rigged everyman + kinetic typography portrays — photoreal Flux cut-outs of made-up people would look generic and off.
